name: Kurisarimon
main_effect: [When Digivolving] If you don't have an [Arata Sanada] card in play, you may play one from your hand without paying its memory cost.
source_effect: [Your Turn] All of your other Digimon with the same name as this Digimon gain ＜Rush＞ (This Digimon can attack the turn it comes into play.).
